newsitem.title: USA: Multiple Zone sees Q2 loss with charge.
newsitem.headline: Multiple Zone sees Q2 loss with charge.

text.p: Multiple Zones International Inc expects second quarter sales to be at least 15 percent below the sequential first quarter level and to post a loss for the quarter, including a charge.
For the quarter ending June 30, Multiple Zones had sales of $122.8 million and net income of $2.1 million or $0.16 a share.
It said the earnings shortfall for the quarter was due primarily to a greater than expected drop in sales of peripheral products for Apple Computer Corp's Macintosh.
Therefore the company said it has launched a shift in operations to focus on personal computers using Intel Corp microprocessors and Microsoft Corp software, or the so-called Wintel platform.
It expects a non-cash charge to second quarter earnings for certain domestic and international Macintosh-related inventory and other assets due to the declining sales.
The charge amount will be announced when second quarter results are released in late July.
Demand for Mac products appears to be weakening at an even faster rate than anticipated, said John DeFeo, Multiple Zones' chief executive said in a statement.
He said efforts to capture growth in the PC/Wintel market in the second quarter are not meeting expectations.

It said it needs to take more aggressive measures to enhance market share. Productivity enhancement programs will also be pursued in recognition of the lower margins that will result from expanding PC/Wintel business. "We expect that it may take several quarters to fully implement these initiatives in the PC/Wintel and corporate markets," DeFeo said.
